S_fixed_point_certificate.matching_lean: Exhaustive check over all proper clause subsets verifies delta(F')<2; therefore the 8-clause formula is matching lean and delta*(F)=delta(F)=2.
S_fixed_point_certificate.surplus: Exhaustive check over all nonempty variable subsets gives sigma(F)=2.
S_fixed_point_certificate.polarity_degrees: Every variable occurs exactly twice positively and twice negatively.
S_fixed_point_certificate.consequence: There are no pure variables and no singular DP variables, and sigma>=2. Hence the published S-reduction has no applicable reduction step on this formula: S(F)=F.

branchwise_descent_on_v2.authority: Exhaustive maximal-deficiency computation over all clause subsets of each simplified child.

exact_DP_projection.exact_semantics: DP_2(F) is logically equivalent to exists x_2 F over the remaining variables and is SAT-equivalent to F.

rank_rebound.conclusion: The natural exact selector-free CNF merge repays and overcompensates the branchwise maximal-deficiency descent.

infinite_lift.construction: Take k variable-disjoint copies of the base formula. Maximal deficiency is additive under variable-disjoint union, so delta*=2k. Branching on the distinguished variable of one copy gives maximal deficiency 2k-1, while DP-projecting that variable gives maximal deficiency 2k+1.
infinite_lift.matching_lean: Variable-disjoint union of matching-lean components is matching lean; any matching autarky would restrict to a nontrivial matching autarky of a component.
infinite_lift.surplus: Each nonempty selected component-variable subset contributes expansion at least 2, so the union still has surplus 2.
infinite_lift.effect: Arbitrarily large exact examples exhibit the same -1 branch descent and +1 DP-merge rebound.

next_admissible_math.question: Is there a concrete exact branch merge whose state is polynomial and whose rank accounts for semantic choice debt without selector reification or DP maximal-deficiency rebound?
